notes: Built from the quaternius.com home page (one request) and each pack page (84 requests, 2 s apart; quaternius.com has no robots.txt). page_license_label is what the pack page shows (82 say CC0, 2 newest say QAL). The site licence page (QAL v1.0, updated 2026-08-28) says it covers assets "regardless of the specific site or platform through which they were obtained": treat every pack as QAL to be safe (free in games, no credit, never re-share the files as assets). Downloads are Google Drive folders (older packs) or itch.io free tiers (newer): the user downloads by hand. Prefer packs whose formats include gltf/glb.
